experiment: Stinging truth-callout hook instead of a generic opener, specific save/send action on slide 7, new hashtag mix focused on discipline/mental-strength tags; posted about 22:00 IST instead of 01:24 IST.

slides.text: You are not busy. You are [[avoiding]] one hard thing.
Comfort feels safe. It is just a [[slow]] kind of loss.
The gap between your words and your actions is [[loud]].
One honest [[hour]] today beats a full year of planning.
Decide. Do one hard thing before you sleep. [[Save]] this and send it to someone who keeps postponing.
